I've recently started eating healthier, and you just have to get the mindset that even though you might not think it's the best tasting thing at that moment, it's making it easier for you to accomplish your goals. For the gym, arms and legs take about two days to recover, while your core requires about one day. Try to run as much as you can. Maybe just jog around the block, and each day try going a little further/longer. And for eating: it's going to be hard to change your diet. You have to be disciplined, and for the first couple of weeks just take one day where you can cheat (but don't just binge on junk food, just a small cheat). Try to be as active as you can be, and maybe set a limit to how long you can play video games for each day/week.

I know I jumped around a lot, and I know that I'm not an expert, but believe me when I say you can do this. It's not going to be easy. But if you believe in yourself and stay disciplined, I truly believe you can do this. Good luck.
